\section{Goblin Infantry}

% With art, the stat block and the image sit side by side; without it, the
% stat block runs full width. Everything below resumes full width either way.
% The `\vspace{0pt}` in each minipage aligns their *tops*: without it `[t]`
% aligns first baselines, and an image's baseline is its bottom edge, which
% would drop the stat block to the foot of the picture.
\textbf{Size:} Small \\
\textbf{Models:} 1x Elite Goblin Infantry, 2x Elite Goblin Infantry, 1x Goblin Infantry \\
\textbf{Type:} Bio, Infantry, Walking \\
\textbf{Points:} 28 \\
\textbf{Shaken:} slow [-, -, Flee] / Can't use weapons

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Take Cover}: [sneak][-2]
\item \textbf{Fire Order}: You may either fire a regular arrow, a special arrow (arrow with limited ammo) or use one thrown weapon with each fire order.
\item \textbf{Evation}: [4+]
\item \textbf{Resistance 2}: Psychic[1] as long as at least one elite model is alive.
\item \textbf{Pre-Assault Retreat}: 6+, improved by 1 per elite in unit.
\end{itemize}


\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Regular}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
0-5 & Kill 1 model \\
6-7 & Kill 1 model, Psychic damage[d6] \\
8+ & Unit destroyed \\
\end{tabular}
\begin{itemize}
\item If one model is killed remove half of the +1 future damage tokens and if killed by bleeding/poison, remove that bleeding/poison token
\end{itemize}
\vspace{1ex}

\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Psychic}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
4+ & shaken \\
\end{tabular}
\vspace{1ex}

\textbf{Equipment:} 1x Goblin Bow, 1x Goblin Grenade, 1x Combat Screw Driver \\

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{To Hit}: +2 to hit with thrown weapons
\end{itemize}
\textbf{Assault:} strength 2,1,1,1 (6+),
deflection 5,0,0,0 (6+),
damage d4-2, AP 2

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Cunning Assault}: [1 for 1]
\item \textbf{Cunning Deflection}: Each deflected hit counts as hits for cunning assault purposes.
\end{itemize}

\section{Heavy Carrier}

% With art, the stat block and the image sit side by side; without it, the
% stat block runs full width. Everything below resumes full width either way.
% The `\vspace{0pt}` in each minipage aligns their *tops*: without it `[t]`
% aligns first baselines, and an image's baseline is its bottom edge, which
% would drop the stat block to the foot of the picture.
\textbf{Size:} Large \\
\textbf{Models:} 1x Heavy Carrier \\
\textbf{Type:} Mechanical, Vehicle, Tracked \\
\textbf{Armor:} 10, 8, 6, 4 \\
\textbf{Points:} 96 \\
\textbf{Shaken:} still [-, -, -] / Can't use weapons

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Transport}: May transport up to 1 Goblin infantry. Deploy order is Deploy(range=1). May deploy directly into assault. If Heavy Carrier enters an assault, you may optionally deploy the infantry to join the assault
\item \textbf{Forward Position}: [1]
\item \textbf{Fire Order}: Fire and load all weapons simultaneously, with identical ammo usage for all weapons
\end{itemize}


\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Regular}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
1-3 & +1 to future damage \\
4 & As 1-3 , shaken \\
5-8 & As 4, d6 critical damage \\
9 & Unit destroyed \\
\end{tabular}
\vspace{1ex}

\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Critical}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
1 & 1d4 damage to all transported units \\
2 & Forced Deploy (empty hexes only) \\
3 & +1 to be hit, -1 to hit \\
4 & Cannot rotate \\
5 & Unit cannot move \\
6 & Fire \\
\end{tabular}
\vspace{1ex}

\noindent\textbf{Damage Table: Crew}

\begin{tabular}{ll}
4-5 & Crippled Crew, if already shaken double initial Crew damage \\
6-7 & As 4-5, shaken \\
8-11 & As 6-7, +3 to future Crew damage \\
12 & Unit destroyed \\
\end{tabular}
\vspace{1ex}

\subsection{Heavy Carrier}

\textbf{Equipment:} 1x Goblin Bow Battery, 1x Heavy Crossbow \\

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{To Hit (2)}: Imprecise weapon[Bow Battery]: -1 to hit
\item \textbf{To Hit (3)}: Enhanced accuracy[Heavy Crossbow]: +1 to hit
\end{itemize}
\textbf{Assault:} strength 16,8,1,1 (6+),
deflection 16,0,0,0 (6+),
damage d6-2, AP 2


\subsubsection{Goblin Bow Battery}

\textbf{Range:} 2, angle True,True,True,True, damage d4 -2, AP 2

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Ammo}: May be loaded (one at a time) with up to 3 ammo
\item \textbf{Multiple Shots}: Fire d12 shots in one fire order per ammo spent, all targeted the same unit.
\item \textbf{Extra Damage}: In addition to normal damage, choose one (for all shots): add Minor Acid, Poison[6] or Gear Disruption[6+]
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection{Heavy Crossbow}

\textbf{Range:} 4, angle True,False,False,False, damage d6, AP 4

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Ammo}: May be loaded (one at a time) with up to 3 ammo
\item \textbf{Multiple Shots}: Fire once per ammo spend per fire order
\end{itemize}
